name: radiate
description: Radiate Studio for AI agents: image, video and audio generation, projects and canvas workflows over Radiate's hosted MCP server, with a price shown before every spend. Preview: points at Radiate's development server.

generate_image.note: per image; depends on model, size and count; estimate first

generate_video.note: per clip; depends on model, length and resolution; Radiate caps one call at 2,500

generate_with_model.note: any catalog model; estimate_model_cost first; Radiate caps one call at 2,500

create_media.note: image, video or audio; estimate first; Radiate caps one call at 2,500

run_canvas_graph.note: sum of the graph's nodes; estimate_canvas_graph_cost first
